- **Per-instance git + jq tracking ADDED (§12-allowed refinement, not in the plan's near-final script):** the plan gave grep per-instance tracking but left git/jq single-shot, so `git log --oneline -- <bank> && git show HEAD:<bank>` and `jq '.' <bank> && jq 'length' <bank>` would have been laundered false negatives inside the arm the plan declares fail-closed. Implemented as `git_check`/`jq_check` evaluated at each new `git`/`jq` token + at end-of-walk; both test-pinned (`test_bash_per_instance_git_no_laundering`, `test_bash_per_instance_jq_no_laundering`). Within §12 "refinements to the git-subcommand / flag detection within the deny-paging-allow-digest intent".
- **Worktree prefix-remap in the wiring class (test refinement, §12 discretion):** settings.json pins the canonical main-root absolute path, which does not exist at that path until this branch merges — a verbatim `Path(cmd).exists()` assert would fail every pre-merge worktree run (incl. the Step 9c full suite). The class remaps ONLY the canonical-root prefix onto the test's own checkout when they differ (detected via `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`); on the main checkout no remap occurs and the configured path is exercised verbatim. A wrong directory, wrong basename, or missing +x still fails under the remap, so the inert-wiring channel stays closed.
- **Not done (must-ask list respected):** no fail-closed flip, no deny-set widening (`china_sensitive_v1.json` stays out per §11.8), escape hatch kept, no extra tools beyond the four, no edits to other hooks, no command rewriting.
